verdict.rationale: Finix explicitly documents separate Sandbox and Live accounts with distinct API credentials, and its test environment lets users simulate live payments (test card payments, fee schemas, payout schedules) without touching production data. This directly matches the story's requirement of a sandbox for testing. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of sandbox fidelity and AI-agent-specific usage of the sandbox (e.g., via MCP) rather than just general developer docs.
